title: Federated Evaluation Contract
summary: Deterministic quality evaluation over one stable set of independently published Shin profile snapshots, with typed provenance assertions and bounded retrieval ceilings.

command.name: federated-eval
command.globalSingleProfileOptions: --profile, --profile-dir, --root, --out-dir, --from-index, and --source-scan are rejected; member locations come only from the reviewed federation config

suite.memberSetRule: requiredMemberIds must equal the complete sorted member-id set resolved from the selected federation config.
suite.pathRule: Evidence paths are exact canonical repository-relative paths; absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.
suite.unknownFieldPolicy: Unknown suite, case, expectation, and member-bound fields are rejected.
suite.hash: suite.content_hash is an FNV identity of the exact suite bytes and is intended for drift detection, not cryptographic authentication.

assertions.mustEvidence: Every expectation must match a returned record by member_ids provenance and exact hit.path; evidenceType and recordType are optional additional constraints.
assertions.mustTopEvidence: Every expectation must match within the first mustTopN global evidence records.
assertions.mustNotEvidence: No expectation may match any returned evidence record.
assertions.expectedEvidenceTypes: Every declared type must occur in the returned global evidence set.
assertions.memberBounds: Returned-record contribution for each member, including retained deduplicated provenance, must remain inside optional inclusive bounds.
assertions.retrievalCeilings: candidate_records and budgeted_out_records must not exceed their declared case ceilings.
assertions.scorePolicy: Suites cannot assert raw scores because scores are member-local and are not cross-profile authority.

ownership: Evaluation fixtures and output are owned by the caller; the engine reads configured inputs and writes only the requested result destination.
nonGoals: no product-specific path or query compiled into C++
no raw-score thresholds or cross-profile score comparison
no distributed transaction, remote lock, daemon, or runtime dependency
verification: Run hermetic arbitrary-member fixtures; deployed integrations require separate authorization and qualification.

snapshotAndLocking.session: One FederationSession resolves the config and acquires every member shared index lock once for the complete suite.
snapshotAndLocking.publicationGuard: A publication-in-progress marker observed after lock acquisition fails the suite closed before retrieval.
snapshotAndLocking.lockLifetime: The shared lock set remains held through all cases and result construction, then is released before the final multi-case JSON report is written.
snapshotAndLocking.memberSnapshotIdentity: Every federation member uses the same active-manifest snapshot_id as its local generated-index commands.
snapshotAndLocking.stableSnapshotSet: Every case must return the same snapshot_set_id; otherwise the suite fails even when individual assertions pass.
snapshotAndLocking.strictFreshness: --strict and --require-current both request exact freshness verification for every member in every case.

result.failureSemantics: Any failed quality case or unstable snapshot set emits the normal result schema with ok=false and exits 1, with or without --strict. Invalid input emits shin.error.v1 and exits 2.
